## Quiet status pulse + display-side JPEG sheets

Builds on **0.1.27**. Mid-cycle acceleration while that release was verifying: status-bar resource pulse and smaller cached preview rasters.

### Status bar
- **Quiet mem · CPU pulse** — compact label like `128M · 12%` on the status bar.
- Samples every **~1.5s** on a single `malgel-pulse` background thread (no aggressive poll); the UI only repaints when the shared generation advances.

### Display-side memory
- **JPEG XL** is not a GPUI `ImageFormat`, so live Typst sheets, Mermaid sharp views, and huge image-viewer downscales use **JPEG (~q82)** in the `Arc<Image>` cache instead of PNG (alpha composited on white). Display fidelity is traded for RAM; GPU upload is unchanged.
- Shared `display_raster` helper; PNG remains the encode fallback.

### Diagnostics / hygiene
- Pulse unit tests; sheet cache asserts JPEG (or PNG fallback).
- Self-tested under Xvfb: Typst preview applies, `malgel-pulse` thread present.
